levels.label: Worlds overall finalist or champion
levels.description: Winning or finalist alliance at the overall FIRST World Championship, beyond the division rounds.

levels.label: Worlds division finalist or champion
levels.description: Winning or finalist alliance in a World Championship division.

levels.label: Worlds participant
levels.description: Recorded match participation or an award at the FIRST World Championship.

levels.label: Regional / state champion
levels.description: Winning alliance at a regional or state championship overall.

levels.label: Regional / state finalist
levels.description: Finalist alliance overall, or winning/finalist alliance in a regional or state championship division.

levels.label: Qualifier / league champion
levels.description: Winning alliance at a qualifier, super qualifier, or league tournament.

levels.label: Qualifier finalist / regional participant
levels.description: Finalist alliance at a qualifier, super qualifier, or league tournament; or recorded regional/state championship participation.

levels.label: 50%+ qualification win rate
levels.description: At least 50% qualification wins at one completed official event with five or more recorded qualification matches.

levels.label: Recorded qualification wins
levels.description: At least one qualification match win, without a higher milestone above.

levels.label: New / no recorded qualification wins
levels.description: A current-season rookie without results, or available official results with no recorded qualification match wins.
